class.name: OcgShapeanalysisWireorder
class.brief_description: This class is intended to control and, if possible, redefine the order of a list of edges which define a wire Edges are not given directly, but as their bounds (start,end)
class.description: ! This class is intended to control and, if possible, redefine ! the order of a list of edges which define a wire ! Edges are not given directly, but as their bounds (start,end) ! ! This allows to use this tool, either on existing wire, or on ! data just taken from a file (coordinates are easy to get) ! ! It can work, either in 2D, or in 3D, or miscible mode ! The tolerance for each mode is fixed ! ! Two phases : firstly add the couples (start, end) ! secondly perform then get the result

method.name: default
method.description: Empty constructor

method.name: from_bool_double_bool
method.description: Creates a WireOrder. Flag <theMode3D> defines 3D or 2d mode. Flag <theModeBoth> defines miscible mode and the flag <theMode3D> is ignored. Warning: Parameter <theTolerance> is not used in algorithm.

method.name: SetMode
method.description: Sets new values. Clears the edge list if the mode (<theMode3D> or <theModeBoth> ) changes. Clears the connexion list. Warning: Parameter <theTolerance> is not used in algorithm.

method.name: Tolerance
method.description: Returns the working tolerance

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the list of edges, but not mode and tol

method.name: Add_1
method.description: Adds a couple of points 3D (start, end)

method.name: Add_2
method.description: Adds a couple of points 2D (start, end)

method.name: Add_3
method.description: Adds a couple of points 3D and 2D (start, end)

method.name: NbEdges
method.description: Returns the count of added couples of points (one per edges)

method.name: KeepLoopsMode
method.description: If this mode is True method perform does not sort edges of different loops. The resulting order is first loop, second one etc...

method.name: Perform
method.description: Computes the better order Optimised if the couples were already in order The criterium is : two couples in order if distance between end-prec and start-cur is less then starting tolerance <tol> Else, the smallest distance is reached Warning: Parameter <closed> not used

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Tells if Perform has been done Else, the following methods returns original values

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status of the order (0 if not done) : 0 : all edges are direct and in sequence 1 : all edges are direct but some are not in sequence -1 : some edges are reversed, but no gap remain 3 : edges in sequence are just shifted in forward or reverse manner

method.name: Ordered
method.description: Returns the number of original edge which correspond to the newly ordered number <n> Warning : the returned value is NEGATIVE if edge should be reversed

method.name: XYZ
method.description: Returns the values of the couple <num>, as 3D values

method.name: XY
method.description: Returns the values of the couple <num>, as 2D values

method.name: Gap
method.description: Returns the gap between a couple and its preceding <num> is considered ordered If <num> = 0 (D), returns the greatest gap found

method.name: SetChains
method.description: Determines the chains inside which successive edges have a gap less than a given value. Queried by NbChains and Chain

method.name: NbChains
method.description: Returns the count of computed chains

method.name: Chain
method.description: Returns, for the chain n0 num, starting and ending numbers of edges. In the list of ordered edges (see Ordered for originals)

method.name: SetCouples
method.description: Determines the couples of edges for which end and start fit inside a given gap. Queried by NbCouples and Couple Warning: function isn't implemented

method.name: NbCouples
method.description: Returns the count of computed couples

method.name: Couple
method.description: Returns, for the couple n0 num, the two implied edges In the list of ordered edges
